concerns.text: Task T023 (correlation analysis) is marked PENDING but depends on T025b (VIF filtering execution). T025b is marked IMPLEMENTED but depends on T021 (descriptor computation). T021d and T021e are marked PENDING. This creates a circular or broken dependency chain: T023 cannot run because T021e (outputting data/descriptors.csv) is missing, yet T021e is listed as pending while T025b claims to have executed on its output. The producer (T021e) must precede the consumer (T025b/T023).

Task T016 (temperature normalization) is marked IMPLEMENTED but explicitly depends on T014b and T014, which are marked PENDING. A task cannot be 'implemented' and produce an artifact (data/cleaned/normalized_thermal.csv) if its required input artifacts (data/raw/thermal_raw.csv from T014b, data/cleaned/provenance_report.json from T014) do not exist. This violates the producer-before-consumer rule.

Task T023c (sensitivity execution) is marked PENDING and depends on T023 (correlation logic). T023 is also PENDING. While the dependency order is correct (T023 before T023c), the entire block is blocked by T021e (descriptor output) and T025b (VIF execution) which are in a contradictory state (T025b claims to run on T021 output, but T021e is pending). The ordering of T021 -> T025 -> T023 -> T023c is semantically broken by the 'IMPLEMENTED' status of intermediate tasks that rely on pending producers.

Task T043 (Execute descriptor computation and correlation) is marked PENDING. It depends on T021, T022, T023, T024. T021d, T021e, T023, T023c are all PENDING. The task list implies these execution tasks can run, but the implementation tasks they depend on are not complete. The ordering is logically sound (Implementation -> Execution), but the 'IMPLEMENTED' flags on T021a-c and T022 create a false state where the pipeline appears ready to run when the data artifacts are missing.
